rationale: Both Jakob and Udula work at the intersection of robotics and machine learning infrastructure—Jakob as a Robotics Software & Data Engineer at New Theory, and Udula as an ML Engineer at RBC Borealis with active robotics projects. They share complementary skill sets: while Jakob brings robotics systems expertise, Udula brings a broad technical foundation (Python, TypeScript, C++) and early-stage engineering experience that could add value to robotics-focused work.
intro_message: Jakob Kaiser, meet Udula Abeykoon — you both work in robotics and ML infrastructure from different angles, and Udula's full-stack engineering background could be useful for your systems work at New Theory.
